```sql
SELECT 
    c.region AS region,
    p.producto_id AS producto_id,
    SUM(i.cantidad) AS unidades
FROM clientes c
JOIN pedidos ped ON c.cliente_id = ped.cliente_id
JOIN items i ON ped.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
JOIN productos p ON i.producto_id = p.producto_id
WHERE ped.estado = 'entregado'
  AND ped.fecha >= '2025-01-01'
  AND ped.fecha <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY c.region, p.producto_id
ORDER BY c.region;
```
